apps.title: Survival War
apps.summary:
Survive the Zombie Outbreak. Control the Dead Zone.

A secret bioweapon experiment has gone wrong.
The zombie virus has consumed Hadforth, a sealed-off industrial town filled with infected streets, ruined shelters, abandoned hospitals, and underground labs.

Now three forces fight for control:

The National Guard wants to contain the outbreak.
Wilmed Biopharma wants to recover samples and erase the evidence.
The infected swarm wants to spread, evolve, and consume everything.

Build your shelter, recruit heroes, search for resources, and lead your squad through deadly outbreak zones. Every mission is a choice: scavenge deeper, fight harder, or extract before you lose everything.

Game Features

Build and upgrade your shelter to survive the apocalypse.

Search abandoned zones for food, supplies, weapons, and rare resources.

Experience search-fight-extract gameplay where every run brings danger and reward.

Train and upgrade heroes with unique skills and squad roles.

Capture key locations and fight tactical battles for control of the town.

Face zombies, mutants, infected nests, and rival factions.

Choose how the outbreak ends: cleanse it, control it, or let it spread.

In this post-apocalyptic zombie survival strategy game, every resource matters, every hero counts, and every expedition could be your last.

Take command, build your shelter, and survive the dead zone.

apps.title: Vial Magic: Color Sort
apps.summary:
Vial Magic: Color Sort is a single-player water sorting puzzle game with a collectible CG illustration gallery. Players solve levels by moving colored liquid between bottles, then progress through the game to unlock pictures for their collection.

WHAT YOU DO IN THE GAME

The main activity is sorting colored water. Each level displays bottles containing several layers of different colors. You must move the liquid between these bottles until every non-empty bottle contains only one color.

The colors remain separate layers. You are organizing them, not mixing them to create new colors.

HOW THE POURING CONTROLS WORK

Tap a bottle to select it, then tap another bottle to pour liquid into it.

A pour is allowed when the destination bottle has enough empty space and either contains no liquid or has the same color on top as the liquid being moved.

Only the uppermost color can be poured. To move a color underneath another layer, you must first remove the liquid above it. You cannot pour into a full bottle or place a color on top of a different color.

Continue moving the layers until the colors are separated into single-color bottles. Bottles that are not needed can remain empty.

EXAMPLE OF A MOVE

If one bottle has blue liquid above red liquid, you must move the blue liquid before you can access the red.

You can pour that blue liquid into an empty bottle or another bottle with blue liquid on top, as long as there is enough room. Removing the blue layer exposes the red layer and creates another possible move.

SOLVING THE LEVELS

Look at the arrangement before choosing a bottle. Empty bottles provide temporary storage and help you reach colors trapped beneath other layers.

A move that matches two colors may still leave you without enough space for the next step. Consider both the color you are moving and the layer that will be exposed afterward.

Completing the sorting objective clears the current level and allows you to continue to the next puzzle.

CG ILLUSTRATION COLLECTION

In addition to the water sorting levels, Vial Magic: Color Sort includes CG artwork, meaning digital illustrations that players can unlock and collect.

Progress through the puzzle levels to meet the game's artwork unlock requirements. Unlocked illustrations become available in the in-game gallery, where you can open and view the pictures you have collected.

The illustrations are collection content, separate from the sorting board. The core gameplay remains moving colored liquid between bottles to solve puzzles.

MAIN FUNCTIONS

Water sorting levels with layered colored liquids.

Tap controls for selecting a source bottle and a destination bottle.

Pouring rules based on matching colors and available bottle space.

Level progression through completed sorting puzzles.

Collectible CG illustrations unlocked through game progress.

An in-game gallery for viewing unlocked artwork.

Vial Magic: Color Sort combines bottle-sorting puzzles with picture collection. Solve the liquid arrangements, advance through the levels, and build your CG illustration collection.

apps.title: Street League Football
apps.summary:
Arcade American football on a street field, where every catch, tackle and juke comes from physics. Chase a high score in Endless, take the hit in Tackle Alley, and win 1v1 route battles online or against the CPU.

Players' bodies and the ball actually collide, so no two plays look the same. Run up a wall, go up one-handed over a defender, or truck the tackler and keep going.

MODES
- Endless: CPU opponents get tougher every round. Three strikes and you're out. Play offense, defense or both and climb the global leaderboards.
- Tackle Alley: carry the ball through a lane of tacklers, or line up as the defender and stop the runner.
- Route Battle 1 on 1: receiver against corner, eight reps, roles swap every two. Play online multiplayer with quick match or a room code, or take on four CPU difficulties.
- 3 on 3: squads, rush counts and route calls, online or against the CPU. Still being built.
- Practice: kickoff returns, quarterback drills and route work.

FREE TO START
The free download includes the tutorial, Tackle Alley with one tackler, Route Battle 1 on 1 against Rookie and Street CPU opponents, and the replay editor. One Full Game purchase unlocks Endless, 3 on 3, kickoff returns, quarterback and route practice, online play, more Tackle Alley defenders, and Legend and Insane CPU difficulty. No ads and no subscriptions. Restore Purchases is in Settings.

MORE
- Replay editor: rewatch any play from new camera angles in slow motion, then save and export the clip.
- Locker: build your player's body, head, hair, gear, cleats and colors.
- Touch controls built for landscape, with a layout editor to move every button. Controllers work too.
- Cross-platform online matches.

Online play needs an internet connection and uses Epic Online Services. Found a problem? Use the in-game Feedback button.

Unwind with Mahjong Pair Crush, a polished mahjong solitaire game for casual players and puzzle lovers who enjoy satisfying tile-pair elimination. This timeless board puzzle blends classic mahjong solitaire rules with smooth, crush-style matching fun, letting you clear intricate layouts at your own relaxed pace, no stressful timers.

Hundreds of uniquely designed puzzle levels await you. Enjoy quick 5-minute casual rounds during breaks, or dive into longer puzzle sessions. Fresh daily mahjong challenges bring brand-new tile structures every day, helping you practice pattern recognition and sharpen your logic skills gradually.

apps.title: King Dies Rich: Roguelike TD
apps.summary:
The king will fall. His fortune won't.

King Dies Rich is a pixel-art roguelike tower defense where the king himself is the tower. Hold the throne against the undead, find powerful loot, and turn every defeat into a stronger kingdom: castle defense, roguelite, and RPG in one game.

HOLD THE THRONE
Your king stays on his throne as enemies close in from every side. Slide a finger to guide the attack circle while he strikes automatically. Pick the most dangerous targets, break up the horde, and survive the next boss. Choose drag or direct touch aiming to suit your play style.

SEVEN SCHOOLS OF POWER
Shape your build with Fire, Frost, Poison, Lightning, Guard, Blades, and Spirits. Burn the undead, freeze a crowd, unleash chain lightning, or surround the throne with blades and spirit archers. Equip matching gear to unlock Mastery and Dominion powers, from falling meteors to volleys of spectral arrows.

LOOT, EQUIP, REFORGE
Collect gear with different bonuses and school effects. Compare finds, equip legendary items, upgrade your favorites, and reforge their properties. Set gems in the throne and combine them into stronger gems as your Kingdom develops.

BUILD A LASTING KINGDOM
Spend the gold you earn on the Arsenal, Citadel, Treasury, Forge, and Mines. Buildings provide lasting upgrades and unlock more ways to improve your king. Your gold, gear, gems, and Kingdom progress stay with you when a siege ends, even if the king falls.

DEEPER HALLS, DEADLIER BOSSES
Battle through the Throne Hall, Crypt, and Chapel. Defeat each hall's boss to open the next, then face tougher enemies in the next circle. Discover the Bone Giant, the Maned and Chained Ghouls, and the Mourner. Fill your Bestiary as you learn what each enemy can do.

KING OF KINGS
After the first circle, King of Kings opens: the weekly race. Compete with other kings and climb from the Bronze league to the Crown league.

PLAY OFFLINE
An offline game for phones and tablets in landscape, with touch controls, adjustable sound, and optional vibration. Only the weekly race needs an internet connection. No account required.

Hold a little longer. Find a better crown. Die rich.

apps.title: Idle Mining & Refining
apps.summary:
Turn raw ore into profit in Ore Mining & Refining, a relaxing idle game filled with moving machines, satisfying crushing and rewarding upgrades!

Tap to drop ore from above and watch it travel through your production line. Pistons, spinning mechanisms and conveyors push each piece toward the crusher, where raw ore becomes valuable metal. Your robots carry the finished metal to the bank, earning you money to upgrade your machines and keep production growing.

⛏️ TAP AND KEEP THE ORE FLOWING

Every production run starts with raw ore. Tap to drop more pieces onto the level and watch your machines move them along. Follow their journey from rough rocks to refined metal!

⚙️ WATCH YOUR MACHINES AT WORK

Let pistons push, mechanisms spin and conveyors carry your ore toward the crusher. Enjoy watching the different parts of your production line work together, moving one piece after another through the level.

💥 CRUSH ORE INTO VALUABLE METAL

Deliver raw ore to the crusher and watch it break into processed metal. Turn a growing stream of rocks into a satisfying flow of valuable materials, ready for your robots to collect.

🤖 COLLECT, DELIVER AND EARN

Your robots handle the next step! Watch them pick up the finished metal and carry it to the bank. Every delivery earns money that you can put straight back into your production line.

📈 UPGRADE YOUR ENTIRE OPERATION

Spend your earnings on improvements throughout the level. Upgrade your ore supply, transport mechanisms, crusher and robots to keep materials moving and make your operation more productive.

🌎 PROGRESS THROUGH DIFFERENT LEVELS

Move on to new levels with different layouts and watch your production take shape. Keep upgrading as you discover the next setup of machines and ore-processing action.

🎮 GAME FEATURES:

• Tap to drop raw ore onto the level
• Move materials with pistons, spinning mechanisms and conveyors
• Crush ore and extract valuable metal
• Watch robots collect and deliver your finished materials
• Earn money and upgrade every part of your production line
• Progress through levels with different layouts
• Enjoy relaxing idle gameplay and satisfying machine action

From the first falling rock to the final robot delivery, every step brings you closer to a bigger and better operation. Keep tapping, keep crushing and keep upgrading!

Start your production line in Ore Mining & Refining!

Explore a playful collection of hands-on skincare, beauty, fashion and styling activities where every level brings a different challenge. Clean up messy details, use treatment tools, try new colors and accessories, then finish each transformation with a three-pose photo shoot.

Clean, Care and Treat

Start with the alligator and work through a dental care routine that includes brace removal, water flossing, bone and lesion removal, teeth cleaning and whitening. Makeover Mini Games

Every animal makeover brings a different routine. Trim the watermelon vines, wipe and moisturize the skin, add eye lenses, lipstick, makeup and face painting, then choose clothes for the final reveal.

The parrot can be finished with masks, eyebrow color, body spray, jewelry, eyewear, earrings and an outfit, giving each character its own personality.

Dress Up and Finish

• Dental, skincare and salon-inspired treatment tools

• Different animals, outfits and accessory combinations
• Three posed photos after every completed level

apps.title: Car Crash: Extreme Jump Test
apps.summary:
Car Crash: Extreme Jump Test is an exciting car crash experience built around speed, jumping, stunts, damage and destruction. Take control of powerful cars, accelerate through challenging tracks and launch from huge ramps to experience spectacular jumps and satisfying crashes. Build up speed, hit the ramp and send your car flying through the air. Control your movement and aim for the right landing as you take on different jumping challenges. Every jump gives you a new opportunity to test your timing, improve your driving and discover how far your car can go.

MASTER THE PERFECT JUMP
Each challenge is designed around a different combination of ramps, obstacles and landing areas. Some jumps require maximum speed, while others need better timing and control. Experiment with your approach, adjust your driving and find the best way to complete every level. Perform exciting car stunts as you launch from ramps and travel through challenging environments. Make longer jumps, reach difficult areas and overcome obstacles along the way. The better you understand each level, the more satisfying it becomes to master the perfect jump.

EXPERIENCE CAR DAMAGE
Crashes are an important part of every challenge. Put your car to the test with hard landings, obstacles and powerful impacts. Experience satisfying car damage and destruction as your vehicle takes on increasingly difficult crash tests. Try different speeds and approaches to see how each crash changes the outcome. Push your car further, take on bigger challenges and discover new ways to create spectacular crashes while working your way through each level.

CHALLENGING STUNT LEVELS
Explore a variety of levels featuring ramps, obstacles, jumps and stunt challenges. Each environment offers a different layout and gives you a new driving challenge to overcome. Find the right route, build enough momentum and use your skills to reach the goal. As you progress, the challenges become more demanding with bigger jumps and trickier obstacles. Improve your timing, control your speed and learn how to approach each ramp for a better run.

FUN ARCADE DRIVING
Car Crash: Extreme Jump Test combines car jumping, crash tests, stunt driving and destruction physics into an easy-to-play arcade experience. The controls are simple to understand, allowing you to focus on driving, jumping and finding the best way through each challenge. Whether you enjoy car crash games, car jump challenges, stunt driving or satisfying destruction, every level gives you another chance to push your car further and improve your performance.

PUSH YOUR CAR TO THE LIMIT
Start your engine and take on exciting car crash challenges. Build speed, hit massive ramps, perform daring stunts and experience incredible jumps. Test your car against obstacles, hard landings and challenging crash scenarios as you discover what happens when you push it further.
Drive fast, jump high and find the perfect way to complete every challenge in Car Crash: Extreme Jump Test.

apps.title: Idle Engine Simulator
apps.summary:
Start with a worn 50cc lawn mower engine and build your way up to a roaring 28-cylinder radial. Idle Engine Simulator is a relaxing engine tycoon game: rev your engine, bolt on better parts, tune it on the dyno and keep earning cash even while you are away.

Every engine has a power target and an efficiency target. Upgrade it part by part, find what is holding it back, and certify it at the redline to unlock the next build. Mopeds, dirt bikes, V-twins, inline-4s, flat-4s, straight-6s, V8s, V12s, W16s and giant radials: 24 engines, each one animated piston by piston, with an engine note to match.

BUILD
• Tap and hold to rev your engine all the way to the redline
• Upgrade intake, exhaust, ignition, fuel, cooling and boost parts
• Badges show what holds you back: bottleneck, overheating, knock or misfire
• Certify each engine for power and efficiency, then build the next one

TUNE
• Dial in air/fuel, spark advance and cam timing by hand
• Choose piston crowns, engine shapes and firing orders
• Race rival engines up the dyno league, from Rookie to Legend

COLLECT AND RESEARCH
• Open toolbox chests and collect 56 part cards in 5 rarities
• Research lasting upgrades in the R&D Lab, even while you are offline
• Daily goals and free daily chests
• Rebuild as Mk II, Mk III and beyond, and keep your cards and research

• Offline earnings while you are away
• Calm, clean visuals and satisfying engine sounds
• No account needed. Your progress is saved on your device.
• Perfect for fans of idle games, tycoon games, car games and engine simulators

Idle Engine Simulator is free to play. It shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases.

apps.title: Wordeex
apps.summary:
Ever been lost for words? Wordeex turns that feeling into a word puzzle game.

16 letters. A hidden set of words. Can you find them?

Each puzzle starts with a keyboard made from the letters of three to five hidden words. Your task is to find those specific words and use every letter.

Find a correct word and its letters disappear, leaving you with the letters you need for the remaining answers. But there’s a twist: a real word isn’t always one of the words you’re looking for.

Sometimes the answer jumps out at you. Sometimes you stare right at it and swear it doesn’t exist.

Then, suddenly, you see it.

That’s Wordeex.

EVERY WORD CHANGES THE PUZZLE
Vocabulary helps. Logic makes the difference. Find a word, watch its letters disappear and take another look at what’s left. Your next answer could be right there.

GUESS, RETHINK, TRY AGAIN
Haven’t found the right word yet? Keep going. Your previous guesses stay visible, and a counter shows when you’ve tried the same word more than once. Yes, it happens.

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
Take on the daily Wordeex, shared by everyone playing in the same language. Solve it and share your result with friends.

EXPLORE THE CHAPTERS
Work your way through puzzles with different levels of difficulty. Some reveal starting letters and word lengths. Others show only the lengths. The toughest reveal neither.

TEST YOUR SKILLS IN ACADEMY
Ready for a greater challenge? Academy is a competitive mode with no hints. It adapts to your skill based on your completion times and number of guesses. As you improve, tackle puzzles with less common words and solve tougher challenges to climb the leagues faster.

CREATE A CHALLENGE OF YOUR OWN
Build your own Wordeex and share it with friends or the community. Can they uncover the words you’ve hidden?

PLAY OFFLINE
No connection? Keep solving Wordeex wherever you are—even in airplane mode.

EXPLORE 27 LANGUAGES
Play in your own language or try one you’re learning. Each language has a dictionary of 3,000 common words. Some will feel familiar. Others might become new favorites.

ALL GAME CONTENT IS FREE
Earn coins by completing puzzles and spend them on hints to help you outside Academy. Wordeex includes ads and optional in-app purchases for coins, ad removal and bundles. You can also choose to watch a rewarded ad after solving a puzzle to double your coin reward.

Think you’ve cracked it?
Find the hidden words. Use every letter. Solve the Wordeex.

apps.title: Pink Pour: Water Sort
apps.summary:
Welcome to Pink Pour Water Sort, a relaxing water-sort puzzle game built around color sorting and careful pouring.

Your goal is simple: pour colored water between bottles until every bottle contains only one color. Tap a bottle to select it, then tap another bottle to pour the top layer of water. Water can be poured into an empty bottle or onto water of the same color. Each level presents a different color arrangement, so you need to observe the order of colors, use empty bottles wisely, and plan your moves carefully.

Each completed level unlocks an entry in the in-game CG gallery. These CG entries are collectible 2D game illustrations that serve as level-completion rewards. You can view unlocked illustrations in the gallery. The CG gallery is a reward and collection feature, while the core gameplay remains water sorting and color classification.

Game features:

Water-sort puzzle gameplay: select bottles, pour water, and sort colors.

Multiple levels with different color arrangements.

Complete levels to unlock in-game CG illustrations and gallery entries.

Undo and restart options to help you adjust your strategy.

Simple tap controls and liquid pouring animations.

Suitable for short breaks or longer play sessions.

Play at your own pace and solve each color-sorting puzzle.

Goal:
Separate the mixed colors so that every bottle contains only one color. Complete the current level to unlock the next level and its corresponding CG gallery reward.

This is a casual puzzle game focused on water sorting and color classification. The in-game CG illustrations are level rewards and collection content.

apps.title: The Collectibles: Ripping+Scan
apps.summary:
The Collectibles is a marketplace and companion app for trading card collectors — Pokémon, One Piece, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh! and more.

MARKETPLACE
Single cards from verified card shops — graded slabs (PSA, CGC and other graders), raw cards, booster packs and sealed products. Every listing shows the set, number, grade and price. Each shop ships its own orders to your door, with its shipping rates stated before you pay.

SCAN ANY CARD
Point the camera at a card, raw or graded, and it is identified and priced in a second.

KNOW WHAT YOUR COLLECTION IS WORTH
Every card is valued daily. Your collection adds up to one number, with its history and the cards that moved most.

THE VAULT
Cards from The Collectibles' own packs are held in our vault, insured and stored free. Have a card shipped to you, or sell it from the vault at the price shown.

PACKS
Each pack holds one real, graded card drawn from a pool you can see before you buy — the cards, their grades, their market values and the chance of each.

COLLECT WITH OTHERS
Post your pulls, follow collectors, message them, and watch live pack openings.

PAYMENTS
Add money to your balance with a card or Google Pay. The balance pays for cards, packs and shipping — physical goods only; nothing digital is sold in the app.

For collectors aged 18 or over.

apps.title: Rummy 500: Classic Card Game
apps.summary:
Welcome to Rummy 500: Classic Card Game – a meticulously crafted offline mobile game that lets you immerse yourself in the strategy and challenge of a classic card game anytime, anywhere! Whether you're a seasoned card player or new to Rummy-style games, enjoy smooth gameplay, smart AI opponents, and comfortable large-font visuals for an authentic Rummy 500 experience. Completely free, no internet needed. Start your journey to 500 points now!

🎯 Objective
In Rummy 500, your goal is to earn points by forming "sets" (three or four cards of the same rank) or "runs" (three or more consecutive cards of the same suit). After each round, players who meld cards score points. The first to reach 500 points wins!
With its fast pace and rich strategy, you'll need to be flexible, observe opponents, and control the game to claim victory.

✨ Features
Authentic Rummy 500 – Faithful to classic rules and scoring for pure card game fun.
Adaptive Smart AI – AI opponents adjust difficulty as you improve, from easy to highly challenging.
Large, Clear Interface – Optimized for mobile with big cards and a clean layout, easy on the eyes.
Offline Play – No internet required. Enjoy a well-designed card game anytime, anywhere.
Stats & History – Track your win rate, high scores, and game history to refine your strategy.
Smooth & Elegant Design – Subtle animations and comfortable colors for a visually pleasing experience.
Completely Free – Built purely for card game enthusiasts.

🃏 How to Play
Draw – Take a card from the deck or discard pile.
Meld – Form and lay down "sets" or "runs" to score points.
Discard – End your turn by discarding one card.
Score – Points are calculated each round based on melds. First to 500 wins.
Includes simple rules – easy for beginners to pick up!

If you love Rummy games or enjoy the strategic challenge of card games like Poker, Hearts, or Bridge, you'll adore Rummy 500. Smart AI, a comfortable interface, and deep strategy – all for pure gaming enjoyment.

apps.title: Just a Squire
apps.summary:
You’re just a squire.

Do the chores. Earn your wages. Buy and merge powerful skills. Transform against impossible odds. Fall in love. And somehow… save the kingdom that ignored you.

All while everyone else gets the glory.

WELCOME TO JUST A SQUIRE

Just a Squire is a story-driven roguelite RPG about an underappreciated squire determined to prove that even the most ordinary person can become a hero.

Your adventure begins with simple duties and a knight who expects far too much. But when strange enemies appear and a mysterious power awakens within you, carrying the bags becomes the least of your problems.

TURN CHORES INTO GOLD

A squire’s work is never finished. At least this time, you’re getting paid.

Tackle playful timing and physics-based mini-games that turn everyday duties into satisfying challenges. Aim carefully, time your moves and earn gold for your hard work. Apparently, saving the kingdom doesn’t excuse you from chores.

BUY, MERGE AND CHOOSE YOUR SKILLS

Build your strategy as each chapter unfolds. Buy skills, merge them into stronger versions and choose combinations that work together.

Spend wisely, adapt to the skills on offer and decide which upgrades deserve your gold. Your next purchase could bring the whole build together.

UNLEASH YOUR TRANSFORMATIONS

Discover different Squire Forms and awaken powerful transformations at unforgettable story moments. Explore new looks, reveal the strength hiding inside you and show everyone what a “mere squire” can really do.

You might look a little different afterward. The chores will still be waiting.

MAKE YOUR SQUIRE YOUR OWN

Collect and upgrade equipment, try different combinations and give your squire a look worth remembering.

Discover Fate gear inspired by the different lives your squire could have lived. From humble jobs to distinctive clans, each look brings another possibility to your adventure. Apparently, being underappreciated comes in several outfits.

COLLECT PETS, MOUNTS AND SENTINELS

Expand your collection with charming pets, impressive mounts and powerful sentinels. Find your favorites and give your adventure a little more company.

Even a squire deserves someone on their side.

TAKE ON SOLO CHALLENGES AND PVP

Venture beyond the story with single-player modes and test your strength against other players in PvP battles.

Put your growing collection and carefully chosen upgrades to work across different challenges. Fight through beautiful fantasy arenas, face strange enemies and find more reasons to get stronger.

LIVE YOUR OWN FANTASY STORY

Meet memorable heroes, rivals, inventors, knights and monsters across unfolding chapters. Survive your knight’s increasingly ridiculous requests. Form unexpected friendships. Fall in love.

Uncover the truth behind a growing darkness and become the unlikely hero standing between the kingdom and an ancient evil.

You may begin as the least important person in the kingdom…

But you won’t stay that way for long.

apps.title: Score Royale
apps.summary:
Score Royale turns a standard 52-card deck into a strategy board. Lay your cards out across five tracks, complete classic card combinations, and settle each track for points. Every card you place changes what the next one is worth.

Each round deals you a full deck and five open tracks. A track holds up to five cards and settles the moment it is full, so the order you play matters as much as the cards you keep. Take the safe pairing, or set a card aside in the swap area and reach for a stronger combination.

Five tracks, five spaces each — arrange all 52 cards and settle every track
Classic card combinations, from a simple pair up to the strongest five-card run
Stacked multipliers — the tougher the combination, the higher the score
Swap area to set a card aside and rebuild your layout
Time and heart rewards added to your final result
Four rooms with different deck counts, timers and target scores
Daily challenges and match history to follow your progress
A guided tutorial covering every combination and multiplier

The four rooms each play differently. Bronze gives you room to learn, Silver and Gold tighten the clock, and Diamond asks for the highest target score of all with the least time to reach it. Beat a room's target score and it stays unlocked. The round also ends when your hearts run out or the last card is played.

Start as a guest in seconds, or register with an email address to carry your progress between devices. If your hearts run out or the clock beats you, one optional rewarded ad lets you continue, once per round.

Score Royale is a single-player card strategy game. In-game coins are earned through gameplay only and cannot be purchased or exchanged.

apps.summary:

In Horde Rush, an endless orc horde floods through the gates at the top of a canyon and rushes for your base. Every orc that gets through costs you. Your job: build an army that holds the line.

The horde moves like a living flood. It squeezes through narrow passes, splits around rocks and piles up against your soldiers. Place your army where it counts and watch the line hold as wave after wave crashes into it.

Summon and level up skills. Rain fire on the horde, blow the orcs back up the canyon or pull them into a whirlwind.

The deeper you go, the bigger the horde gets. Brutes, Big Orcs, Spear Orcs and plenty more march with the crowd and take far more to bring down.

BATTLEFIELDS
Every level is a new battlefield: winding roads, funnels, split canyons, islands, three-gate assaults and more. Each map changes how the horde moves and where your line should stand.

GROW STRONGER WITH EVERY RUN
Prestige to earn crowns and spend them on permanent upgrades for your whole army and on upgrade paths for every unit. Your army keeps earning while you are away, too.

How far can you hold the canyon?

apps.title: Sort Streak: Color Puzzle
apps.summary:
🌸 SORT STREAK: COLOR PUZZLE 🌸

Sort, match, and arrange colorful flowers in a satisfying sorting puzzle adventure!

Sort Streak is a relaxing color sorting puzzle game and matching game that combines simple drag-and-drop gameplay with thoughtful planning. Colorful flowers are arranged on ropes, and your goal is to sort flowers by color, match them to the right rope, complete objectives, and fill flower pots.

The gameplay is easy to learn, but every move matters. Rearrange the flowers, manage limited rope space, and find the best solution for every puzzle level. Whether you want to relax or train your logical thinking, Sort Streak offers a colorful and satisfying puzzle challenge.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY

• Pick up a flower or a connected group of flowers from a rope.
• Drag the flowers onto an empty rope.
• You can also place them onto a rope with the same color at its free end and enough space.
• Sort and match flowers by color while carefully planning each move.
• Complete a full group of flowers on the matching rope.
• Watch the completed group collect into a flower pot.
• Complete all objectives and fill the required pots to clear the level.

Every move can change the entire board. Look ahead, rearrange the flowers, and use the available rope space wisely. If there are no legal moves left, the level ends. Can you overcome every sorting challenge and complete the objectives?

✨ WHY YOU’LL LOVE SORT STREAK

• Relaxing color sorting gameplay that is easy to learn.
• Simple drag-and-drop controls for an intuitive matching game experience.
• Colorful flowers, ropes, and satisfying sorting animations.
• Puzzle levels ranging from easy introductions to challenging arrangements.
• Different levels and layouts that keep the sorting adventure fresh.
• Helpful tools, including Hint, Undo, and Add a Rope.
• Satisfying flower grouping and flower pot collection feedback.
• A casual puzzle game for a quick break or a longer gameplay session.
• A fun way to practice logical thinking, spatial planning, and problem-solving.

🔮 SPECIAL PUZZLE MECHANICS

Mystery Flowers add surprise to your color sorting adventure. Move the flowers underneath to bring a Mystery Flower to the end of the rope and reveal its true color. Once revealed, the flower can be sorted and matched according to the color rules.

Locked Flowers create new obstacles and objectives. Locked flowers cannot be moved until you complete the required color objective or the required number of group objectives. Unlock new possibilities, rearrange the ropes, and find a way through each challenging puzzle level.

As you progress, the flower arrangements become more complex. You will need to read the flower order, overcome obstacles, manage limited space, and choose every move carefully.

🧠 SORT, MATCH, AND TRAIN YOUR BRAIN

Sort Streak gives you a peaceful break while encouraging logical thinking, spatial planning, and problem-solving. Take your time to sort colorful flowers, match the right colors, complete objectives, and enjoy the satisfying feeling of solving a puzzle.

Whether you enjoy sorting games, matching games, color sorting puzzles, brain teasers, or casual puzzle games, Sort Streak offers an easy-to-learn experience with satisfying challenges for every puzzle fan.

Can you sort every flower, overcome every obstacle, unlock every possibility, fill every flower pot, and solve every puzzle? 🌸

Start playing Sort Streak today and enjoy a colorful sorting puzzle adventure!

apps.title: Candy Cannon Sort
apps.summary:
Aim. Fling. Watch the tubes ERUPT!

Candy Cannon Sort mixes ball sort with a bubble shooter. Instead of moving balls from tube to tube, you fire glossy candy balls from a cannon straight into glass tubes. Fill a tube with 4 balls of one color and it erupts in a geyser of rainbow confetti and clears.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag back and let go (or just tap a tube) to fling the loaded candy.
• Watch the chute: you can see the next balls coming, so plan ahead.
• 4 of one color in a tube = SWEET! The tube erupts and empties.
• Every eruption shakes the wrong balls off the neighboring tubes. They fly home into a matching tube or back into your cannon.
• Clear every color to win. Run out of room and the level is over.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP PLAYING
• Chain reactions: one good shot can set off SWEET, GREAT, AMAZING and SUGAR RUSH combos in a row, each one louder and bigger than the last.
• Big payoffs: rainbow confetti, candy rain and a LEVEL CLEAR party on every win.

apps.title: Word Connections Master
apps.summary:
🔍 What do some words have in common that others simply do not?

That question is at the heart of every puzzle in Word Connections Master, the word game that trains you to see what is hiding between the words.

Every level places a group of words in front of you. Some seem completely unrelated. But look closer, and a connection begins to emerge. A hidden category. An association that was there all along, waiting for you to notice it.

🧩 HOW THE GAME WORKS
This word association game gives you a group of words and one goal: group them by their hidden connection. Four words per category. Multiple categories per level. Each correct association locks in. Each wrong guess makes you look again. The game never rushes you. It simply waits, patiently, for the moment the connection clicks.

And when it does? That feeling is unlike any other word game.

🔎 WHAT MAKES A CONNECTION?
In this game, associations come from everywhere. Sometimes the connection is a shared category, such as colours, animals, or countries. Sometimes it is a concept like: words that all follow something, or precede something, or describe the same feeling. Sometimes the association is so unexpected that you will stop and smile when you find it.

That is the magic of this word game. The connections are always logical. They are just not always obvious.

💡 WHAT YOU WILL DISCOVER
🔹Word associations you never knew existed
🔹Categories and connections that span language, culture, nature, and everyday life
🔹A new way of reading words, not just for meaning, but for the hidden relationship
🔹How much your vocabulary and general knowledge can surprise you
🔹That the most satisfying game moments come from connections you almost missed

🎯 WHAT THE GAME BUILDS
🔸Stronger word association skills with every puzzle you solve
🔸A richer vocabulary and deeper understanding of language
🔸Pattern recognition that sharpens the more you play
🔸A calmer, more curious way of approaching problems
🔸Confidence in finding connections where others see none

📦 WHAT IS INSIDE
🔹Hundreds of word association puzzles across dozens of unexpected themes
🔹A game that grows in depth the further you explore
🔹Progressive difficulty, early connections welcome you, later ones will make you wonder
🔹A gentle hint system that nudges without spoiling the association
🔹New word connections and game puzzles added regularly
🔹Clean, minimal design that keeps the focus on the words

🌟 A WORD GAME THAT ASKS MORE OF YOU
Most word games ask you to spell, or to guess, or to find. Word Connections Master asks you to understand — to see the relationship between words that, on the surface, share nothing at all.

It is a game about curiosity. About the pleasure of a pattern recognised. About the quiet thrill of a connection finally made. How many will you find?

👉 Download the game for free. Your favourite word association is waiting.

📧 We're always improving and genuinely love hearing your feedback. If you have any suggestions or feedback, write to us at support@quriousbit.com

apps.title: Domino Blast: Block Puzzle
apps.summary:
Drop blocks. Clear a line. Watch the dominoes fall!

Domino Blast is a colourful block puzzle with a twist. Drag block pieces onto an 8x8 board to fill rows and columns. The dominoes standing on the board count as filled cells too.

Complete a line with a domino in it and the domino tips over. It rushes across the board along its arrow, smashes every block in its path and knocks over the next domino. Chains turn corners, and the fallen dominoes can complete even more lines. One smart move can set off a huge chain reaction.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a piece from the tray onto the board
• Fill a full row or column to clear it
• Topple the dominoes and let the chain do the rest
• Free every domino, or smash the target number of blocks, to clear the level
• No piece fits? You're out of room. Try again, or call in a Domino Drop

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• One simple move, easy to learn in seconds
• Big chain reactions with bursts, shakes and rising combo sounds
• Bright, glossy candy colours that are easy to read
• Short levels that flow straight into the next one
• Rainbow dominoes that tip in every direction
• A reward chest every few levels
• Endless levels: ice blocks, bombs and stone walls join the board as you go
• Boss levels with giant chains, and a fresh world look every 40 levels
• Plays offline, no Wi-Fi needed (ads and ad rewards need a connection)

Domino Blast is free to play. It contains ads, including optional reward ads.

Line up the pieces, tip the first domino and blast the board clean!
